parts.text: $DCH: revenue surged 93% to $2.9B, but Q3 2026 (preliminary) ended in a net loss of $45M. 👇 #earnings #autos
$PPL: revenue growth sped up to +12% from +4% the quarter before. Q3 revenue $2.5B, operating margin 26.6% (preliminary). 👇 #earnings #utilities
$OPTU: revenue fell 5% to $2.0B as surging costs drove a $2.9B net loss for the quarter. 👇 #earnings #media
$CLMT: revenue grew 56% to $1.7B (preliminary), but net earnings fell 18% to $256M as expenses jumped. 👇 #earnings #oil
$PAA: revenue grew 31% to $15.2B (preliminary), but operating margin slipped to 3.4% as costs rose. Q3 net earnings $363M. 👇 #earnings #industrials
$GLP: higher sales, thin margins — Q3 revenue +42% to $6.7B, operating margin 1.3%. Net earnings reached $43M (preliminary). 👇 #earnings #industrials
$BEN: profit is growing faster than sales — operating margin reached 14.6% in Q4 FY26 (preliminary), up from 3.7% a year ago. Revenue +4% to $2.4B. 👇 #earnings #finance
$FCNCA: about 33¢ of every revenue dollar is operating profit, up from 31¢ a year ago. Q3 2026 revenue flat at $2.4B while total costs fell 3%. 👇 #earnings #banks
$TXRH: steady growth with tighter margins — revenue +10% to $1.6B, operating margin 6.5%. Q3 net earnings reached $89M. 👇 #earnings #restaurants
$DKNG: revenue grew 16% to $1.3B, but costs outpaced sales with sales & marketing up 68%, pushing operating margin to −37.1%. 👇 #earnings #media
$ELAN: cash came in well ahead of profit — operating cash flow $216M was 1200% of net earnings on $1.3B revenue (+11% Y/Y). 👇 #earnings #pharma
$UAA: revenue fell 7% to $1.2B and profit vanished — operating margin slipped to 1.2% while the quarter ended in a net loss of $425K. 👇 #earnings #consumer
